paragraphs: Rami bar Baruchi: [Sanhedrin 17b](https://www.sefaria.org/Sanhedrin.17b.6) and [Rashi on Beitzah 8b](https://www.sefaria.org/Rashi_on_Beitzah.8b.10.1), according to the reading cited by Hyman.[^1]

notes.text: The consulted Sanhedrin has Rami bar Berabi. Rashi on Beitzah refers back to that passage and has Rami bar Beribi. The edition with Hyman’s Baruchi spelling remains uncollated.
